MB draws on 'Biochemistry, Human Genetics, Neurobiology, Oncological Sciences, Pharmacology and Toxicology, the School of Biological Sciences, and the Division of Microbiology and Immunology'. The Faculty Research Index lists faculty as 'Last, First' with program tags; the matcher missed them, but it shows 'Hill, Chris' -> 'MB, BC' and 'Safavi, Helena' -> 'MB, BC'. Christopher P. Hill was matched by the matcher on the Biochemistry department faculty page (a participating department). Human Genetics graduate page (https://www.genetics.utah.edu/graduate-program-overview-how-to-apply): 'The Department of Human Genetics offers graduate education in modern molecular genetics. Ph.D. candidates enter the Department through one of the campus-wide programs: the' followed by links 'Molecular Biology Program', 'Biological Chemistry Program', 'Neurosciences Graduate Program' - so there is no separate Human Genetics PhD.
